verdict.rationale: sevDesk can be driven headlessly through its own REST API. It publishes a full OpenAPI 3.0 spec, issues long-lived API tokens suited to unattended scripts, and points users to cURL/Postman for calls. There is no first-party CLI, no documented CI integration, and no sandbox mode: testing needs a separate trial account. Missing for 10: official CLI or headless runner, CI/pipeline integration docs, sandbox or test-mode environment, independent hands-on corroboration of automated use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The REST API lets you manage data and features in sevdesk and connect external services to sevdesk.
sevdesk publishes its full OpenAPI 3.0.0 document (671 KB YAML, base https://my.sevdesk.de/api/v1) as a downloadable file
The api tokens have an infinite lifetime
